preamble.summary: Deuteronomy 17 contains the kingship law, including the famous requirement that the king copy and read the Torah daily (vv. 18–20). 4QDeutᶠ preserves fragments. Coverage is moderate.
preamble.notable_variants: No significant content variants. The kingship-law restrictions and the royal-Torah command read identically to MT.

variant_notes: The royal-Torah command ('he shall write for himself a copy of this Torah') tracks MT.
